rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese choice for a personal diary or daily record.

example.english: I write in my journal every day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 se2 jat6 gei3

rows.note: Use this for an organizational, work, vessel, or other log rather than a personal diary.

example.english: The department has to update the journal every day.
example.traditional: 部門每日都要更新日誌。
example.jyutping: bou6 mun4 mui5 jat6 dou1 jiu3 gang1 san1 jat6 zi3

rows.note: Use this for a general magazine or subject-focused periodical rather than a scholarly publication.

example.english: This journal is all about travel.
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 zaap6 zi3 zyun1 gong2 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this specifically for an academic or scholarly journal.

example.english: This paper has already been published in an academic journal.
example.traditional: 呢篇論文已經刊登喺學術期刊。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 leon6 man4 ji5 ging1 hon1 dang1 hai2 hok6 seot6 kei4 hon1
